from pathlib import Path
folder=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-medium-fresh0/frozen/held-out-reference-2/play/users/u092/system/state/workspace/programs')
folder.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    points = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 1]
    if len(points) < 2:
        return out
    dr = points[1][0] - points[0][0]
    dc = points[1][1] - points[0][1]
    r, c = points[-1]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    while 0 <= r + dr < h and 0 <= c + dc < w:
        r, c = r + dr, c + dc
        if out[r][c] == 0:
            out[r][c] = 2
    return out
'''
path=folder/'task-d32a5bcb.py'
path.write_text(code)
exec(compile(code,str(path),'exec'),globals())
test=[[0]*15 for _ in range(15)]
for r,c in [(0,0),(3,3),(6,6)]: test[r][c]=1
out=transform(test)
print([(r,c,v) for r,row in enumerate(out) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v])
